name: How long does mobile home trim repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does mobile home trim repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most mobile home trim repairs take between a few hours and two full days, depending on the project scope. Fixing a single warped door casing or loose baseboard strip is typically handled in an afternoon. Replacing trim throughout an entire room or mobile home involves measuring, removing old batten strips or molding, cutting custom corners, caulking seams, and applying finish paint, which extends the schedule. If trim damage was caused by water intrusion or shifting walls, extra time is needed to repair the underlying drywall or subfloor before new trim can be installed securely.
acceptedAnswer.description: A minor trim repair can be completed in a few hours, while full-room trim replacement and painting typically take one to two days depending on wall prep needs.
